'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Ukraine is prioritized first among the countries to receive ordered deliveries of [[MIM-104 Patriot]] missile systems from the [[United States]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/20/politics/ukraine-us-air-defense-capabilities/index.html (CNN)]
***United States officials announce that they will allow Ukraine to use US weapons to strike Russian forces within Russia, provided they are located right across the border with Ukraine, removing the prior limit of only allowing strikes across the [[Kharkiv]] front. [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/06/20/us-says-ukraine-can-hit-inside-russia-anywhere-00164261 (Politico)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Three people are killed and four others are injured in [[Russia]]n [[cluster munition]]s strikes on the village of Rozkishne, [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/21/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-847 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Rapid Support Forces]] captures [[Al-Fulah]], the capital of [[West Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], after the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] withdraw from the city after several hours of fighting. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/20/sudans-rsf-captures-key-army-stronghold-of-el-fula (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Orca Shipwreck]]
**The [[Israel Antiquities Authority]] announces the discovery of a 3,300-year-old ship and its cargo, one of the oldest known examples of a ship sailing far from land. The ship was discovered last year by a company drilling for [[natural gas]] off the coast of [[Northern District (Israel)|Northern Israel]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/israel-sunken-ship-ancient-navigation-archaeology-rcna158012 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Hajj disaster]]
**At least 1,081 [[pilgrim]]s are now confirmed to have died from heat-related causes during the [[Hajj]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240620-death-toll-tops-1-000-after-hajj-marked-by-extreme-heat-afp-tally (France 24)]
*[[2024 Tamil Nadu alcohol poisoning]]
**At least 36 people are killed and more than 60 others are hospitalized after [[List of methanol poisoning incidents#India|consuming tainted liquor]] in [[Kallakurichi district]], [[Tamil Nadu]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/least-31-die-indias-tamil-nadu-state-after-consuming-tainted-liquor-2024-06-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/tamil-nadu/2024/Jun/21/death-toll-in-kallakurichi-hooch-tragedy-rises-to-49 (''New Indian Express'')] 
*A [[cruise ship]] rescues 68 [[list of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|migrants]] and finds five bodies in a wooden [[dinghy]] that was drifting off the [[Canary Islands]], [[Spain]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/cruise-ship-rescues-68-migrants-finds-5-bodies-111274018 (ABC News)]
*At least two people are killed and nine others are injured when a passenger train [[train wreck|collides]] with a train on a test run near [[Santiago]], [[Chile]]. [https://apnews.com/article/chile-train-collision-san-bernardo-57a473185042654ccd6e1de13b003b44 (AP)]
*[[Kuwait]] announces temporary [[power cut]]s in parts of the country during peak consumption hours, saying that the country is struggling to meet increased demand caused by extreme summer heat. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2024/06/20/kuwait-announces-power-cuts-as-demand-spikes-in-summer-heat (Al Arabiya)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[United States Senate|U.S. Senators]] [[Richard Blumenthal]] and [[Lindsey Graham]] move to designate [[Russia]] a [[State-sponsored terrorism|state sponsor of terrorism]] after its defensive pact with North Korea. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2024/06/20/us-senators-move-to-designate-russia-state-terrorism-sponsor-after-north-korea-pact/ (''The National'')]
*Outgoing [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Dutch Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] is announced as the next [[Secretary General of NATO]], beginning his term on October 2. [https://www.politico.eu/article/mark-rutte-will-be-natos-next-secretary-general/ (''Politico'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[ChinaAngVirus disinformation campaign]]
**[[Congress of the Philippines]] lawmakers pursue an investigation into a U.S. military social media disinformation operation to discredit [[China|Chinese]] [[CoronaVac|COVID-19 vaccines]] to [[Filipinos]] to determine the damages caused, international law infringements, and possible legal action. [https://www.reuters.com/world/lawmakers-philippines-push-probe-into-pentagons-anti-vax-propaganda-operation-2024-06-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Vandalism of Stonehenge]]
**The orange powder paint sprayed on [[Stonehenge]] by [[Just Stop Oil]] activists yesterday is removed with a handheld [[blower fan]], leaving no visible damage. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crgg0683e7po (BBC News)]
*Two [[Just Stop Oil]] [[activist]]s film themselves cutting through a metal fence and spraying orange paint on two [[private jet]]s at [[Stansted Airport]] in [[Essex]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [[Essex Police|Police]] arrest the activists for [[criminal damage]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9eedx9legpo (BBC News)]
*A tourist accused of [[Quran desecration|desecrating the Quran]] is removed from a police station in [[Swat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], by a mob who beat him to death before setting his corpse on fire. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/06/21/mob-in-pakistan-kills-man-accused-of-burning-quran (Al Arabiya)]
*The [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom]] rules that the future impact of proposed fossil fuel projects must be assessed, when considering site proposals for drilling. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/article/2024/jun/20/landmark-supreme-court-ruling-throws-doubt-on-new-uk-fossil-fuel-projects (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[Japan]]ese [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Japan)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] announces sanctions on firms based in China, India, [[Kazakhstan]], and [[Uzbekistan]], for their alleged support to Russia in the [[Russo–Ukrainian war]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2024/6/21/japan-sanctions-china-based-firms-accused-of-supporting-war-in-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed, at least 200 people are injured, and over 100 are arrested in protests across [[Kenya]] against [[Government of Kenya|government]] plans to raise $2.7 billion in additional taxes. [[Kenya Police]] fired live rounds, tear gas, and water cannons at protesters. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/over-200-injured-100-arrested-kenya-tax-protests-rights-groups-2024-06-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2024 in archosaur paleontology]]
**Researchers announce the discovery of the ''[[Lokiceratops|Lokiceratops rangiformis]]'', a dinosaur species named after the [[Norse mythology|Norse god]] [[Loki]], in [[North America]]. The findings are published in the journal ''[[PeerJ]]''. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/new-horned-dinosaur-species-discovered-largest-ornate-kind/story?id=111245903 (ABC News)]
*The [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]] announces that the [[Iberian lynx]] has been upgraded from [[endangered species|endangered]] to [[vulnerable species|vulnerable]] for the first time since 1986, after a 2023 [[census]] showed a population of 2,021 animals. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cyxxz51vwz2o (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[UEFA Euro 2024]], [[Anti-Serb sentiment]]
**[[Serbia national football team|Serbia]] threatens to withdraw from UEFA Euro 2024 if [[UEFA]] does not punish [[Croatia national football team|Croatia]] and [[Albania national football team|Albania]] after their supporters chant "kill, kill, kill the [[Serbs|Serb]]" during a match in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]], on Wednesday. [https://news.sky.com/story/serbia-threatens-to-pull-out-of-euro-2024-over-croatia-and-albania-chants-13156050 (Sky News)]
